summary: Full authenticated E2E of Life OS. Seeded fixture user (test-session-lifeos-fixture-0001) works end-to-end. Backend: 21/21 pytest cases pass covering auth boundary, workspace shape, onboarding (document, conversational, commit), daily logs (sleepHours + domainsTouched + rest day), tasks (create + due date + link domain + PATCH toggle + 404), reflection (generate + edit + save), companion (normal LLM draft + crisis safety fallback with 988), and per-user isolation via bad-token 401. Frontend: authenticated shell loads via localStorage lifeos_token, disclaimer visible, mood/sleep/domains/rest/save-checkin working with toast, tasks tab creates a task with web-due chip and links a domain, Reflect tab loads saved AI draft with 'This week/This month' toggle plus mood/sleep/tasks/rest tiles, Companion returns AI drafts and crisis fallback text including '988', Onboarding Path B (questionnaire) walks q-next 6 times and lands on editable review with north-star-input, tone chips, and domain editors. No React Native red screens. No deprecated Expo packages detected in this file (expo-notifications used properly).

issues: Domain balance neutral fact copy like 'last logged N days ago' was requested but the UI only surfaces mood/sleep/tasks/chosen-rest tiles plus the LLM paragraph; no explicit per-domain 'last logged N days ago' badges rendered.

action_items: OPTIONAL: If per-domain 'last logged N days ago' neutral facts are a product requirement, add them explicitly to the Reflect screen (currently only aggregate tiles + LLM paragraph are shown).
OPTIONAL: Backend Pydantic models do not clamp moodScore (1-5), sleepHours (>=0), or targetFrequency (1-7); add validators to reject invalid values instead of silently persisting.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `current_user` correctly rejects missing/invalid/expired tokens; MongoDB `_id` is excluded in all reads.
server.py: `POST /api/logs` deletes any prior log with same date+user before insert -> idempotent daily entry.
server.py: crisis keyword list is explicit (kill myself, suicide, self-harm, end my life, hopeless) and returns isSafety=true without invoking the LLM. Verified via test.
index.tsx (347 lines): single-file architecture; consider splitting per-tab components into /components once file exceeds 700 lines. Currently under threshold.
index.tsx: web-only due-date chips (web-due-*) provide accessible fallback when DateTimePicker cannot render on web.

success_rate.frontend: 8/8 flows (100%) - auth shell, disclaimer, check-in, tasks create+link, reflection draft, companion normal, companion crisis 988, onboarding Path B review

seed_data_creation: Ran /app/backend/seed_test_user.py which upserts user_testfixture01 + session token test-session-lifeos-fixture-0001. UI test also committed 3 TEST_* domains (Sleep/Movement/Family) and a TEST_UI Task via the frontend for the fixture user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://companion-compass.preview.emergentagent.com. Seed the fixture with `cd /app/backend && python seed_test_user.py` before runs. For UI, use page.add_init_script to set localStorage lifeos_token BEFORE reload. Pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_lifeos_backend.py and is safe to rerun (idempotent: uses date-keyed logs, TEST_ prefixed domains via commit-replaces, and PATCH by returned id).
rca_of_issue: No blocking bugs found. Prior iterations were blocked by missing test identity; the deterministic fixture (seed_test_user.py + test_credentials.md) now unblocks authenticated E2E. All requested feature areas (Auth, Onboarding A/B/commit, Daily check-in with real sleepHours + multi-domain + rest, Tasks with dueDate + domain link + PATCH, Reflection generate/edit/save, Companion normal + safety fallback, permanent disclaimer) are functional at both API and UI layers.
